name: PGIA-140-80
summary: PGIA-140-80 is a DH-Robotics industrial electric parallel gripper with 80 mm travel, up to 140 N gripping force per jaw and IP54 protection. It supports programmable gripping in handling and production equipment, with revised cable routing compared with the earlier PGI model.
